svg.title: Throughput per scenario, latest run
svg.desc: Latest recorded run: 2026-11-14T16:01:27Z (commit f1545cbb). Requests per second at fixed concurrency; each panel has its own scale. A panel with a single bar is a scenario only that proxy runs (browser-check, or one the others skip). rate-limited, error-page and rewrite-redirect count every response (429, 502 and 302), not only 2xx. websocket counts echo round trips (a message each way) per second.
